cs.bg2: It was clear to me that I wanted to do an apprenticeship as a computer scientist after compulsory school. Thus, since 2020, I have been practicing as a computer scientist in systems engineering at a cybersecurity company and have turned my hobby into my profession.

s1.title: Pre-production
s1.description: Planning a project is an essential part when realizing a short film / commercial / trailer. I took over this step by taking the base story and idea of the client and writing a screenplay, shot list and more around it.

s2.title: Film Production
s2.description: On the first day of the project the filming of the trailer/short film was done. The production took roughly 6 hours and was rather on a budget in regards of time and money. The base idea for the trailer and short film came from the client. I was responsible for all the cinematography and lighting used to produce the piece.

s3.title: Post-production
s3.description: After filming and shooting stills, the post-production phase began. It consisted of assembling a rough edit first, which then was discussed with the client to implement further changes. After effects, color grading and sound design were complete, further revisions were created. I always showed the customer the state of the project and implemented his feedback to improve the final product as much as possible. I also composed a small soundtrack to fit the film's mood and edited the stills I shot on the second day.

s4.title: Photo Shooting
s4.description: On the second day of the project, a photo shooting was done. Those pictures were then used for promotion and on the website.

sxclout.intro1: For a local clothing company called sxclout I got the honor to realize a project consisting of a short film/trailer and a photo shooting.
sxclout.intro2: The project was rather budget-like in terms of money, time and equipment.
sxclout.intro3: I used the project to further improve my skills in realizing film and photography projects as well as improving customer relation, planning and logistics.

jublasurium.intro1: Jublasurium was the 2025 national Pentecost camp of Jungwacht Blauring, Switzerland's largest Jubla youth gathering, bringing together thousands of participants from across the country.
jublasurium.intro2: I was part of the on-site content team, responsible for producing daily Instagram reels that recapped each day of camp life for everyone following along at home: shooting, editing and publishing a new recap before the next day began.
